context: Sho meets Kenji at the city office for a job interview prep talk.
purpose: Adult mentor coaching teen on professional self-presentation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 面接、何を準備すればいい?
lines.en: What should I prepare for the interview?
lines.style: earnest teen boy, nervous but determined, careful enunciation throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 質問の練習、それだけで違うで。
lines.en: Practising the questions alone changes everything.
lines.style: experienced Kansai mentor voice, grounded patient warmth throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I don't have any qualifications yet.
lines.style: self-conscious teen voice, soft worry tone, honest admission

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 資格より、人柄が大事や。
lines.style: firm Kansai elder voice, fatherly reassurance softly delivered

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 会議室、緊張するんかな。
lines.en: Will the conference room make me nervous?
lines.style: curious teen boy, anxious anticipation in his voice

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 深呼吸して、笑顔で入れ。
lines.en: Take a deep breath and walk in smiling.
lines.style: calm Kansai mentor, soft instructional kindness throughout delivery

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん、覚えとく。ありがとう。
lines.style: softer teen boy, grateful trusting smile in voice
